text:
Alex Park: Quick sync — starting planning for the joint GPU efficiency/throughput runs with Aurora Hardware. Main goals: perf/W curves, steady-state throughput, and kernel tuning impact. Propose dates next Tue/Wed for isolated runs.
Maria Lopez: +1. I'll own the test matrix mapping to our runtime profiles and quant suggestions. Need partner HW SKUs and firmware versions.
Kevin Chen: Looping in eng-infra — do we have reservation windows for isolated pools? prefer air-gapped nodes for reproducibility. @eng-infra
Samira Patel: Partner side: they can provide two chassis: A100x2 and A100x8 (firmware v6.2). They want a dry run first (2h) then a 24h long run. NDA already signed.
Jen O'Neil: Telemetry checklist: GPU_power_w, host_power_w, p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens_per_sec, KV cache hit%, temperature, and raw perf counters (SM utilization). Also record model version and kernel build hash.
Alex Park: Suggested minimal matrix to start (dry run):
```
models: rwd-3b, rwd-7b
seq_len: 512, 1024, 2048
quant: fp16, int8
batch_size: 1, 4
kernels: baseline, tuned-v1
```
Samira Patel: That looks good. For the long run we should add bursty traffic curves and sustained throughput at target token rates. Partner asks we keep any public numbers embargoed until joint announcement.
Maria Lopez: I'll produce an initial CSV of combinations and mark high-priority cells. We should flag combos that trigger OOM or extreme throttling so we don't waste partner time.
Kevin Chen: From infra: we can reserve 12 hours on Tue (dry + prep) and 36 hours Wed. Will provide an instrumented image with nvidia-smi logging + telegraf for host power. Need a contact for setting up power meters in the rack.
Alex Park: Samira, can you share the on-site tech contact and preferred time window? Also confirm if they will allow kernel repro builds (we may need their driver team for symbol access).
Samira Patel: I'll share contact (will DM). They are ok with kernel repro builds but require our engineers to sign a short addendum for driver debug access.
Jen O'Neil: For data pipelines: export raw logs to S3 bucket with lifecycle of 90 days, and produce a normalized report with perf/W curves + heatmap per SKU. I'll create a dashboard template in the console.
NVIDIA Bot: [automated] Test image build queued. Expected completion: 48h.
Alex Park: Great — action items: Maria produce matrix by EOD Friday, Kevin reserve nodes + image, Samira share contact + addendum, Jen prep dashboard template. We'll meet Mon 10am PT to finalize. :thumbsup:
Kevin Chen: ack, reserving nodes now.
Maria Lopez: ack, will drop CSV and quick viz by EOD.
Samira Patel: ack, will DM contact and addendum later today.
Jen O'Neil: ack, dashboard stub by Monday morning.
Alex Park: Thanks team — let's keep notes here for the run. :rocket:
